Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows mild leukopenia, anemia, and thrombocytopenia, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or chronic disease. There is dyslipidemia (elevated cholesterol, LDL, and triglycerides) and poor glycemic control (elevated HbA1c). Liver and renal function are within normal limits, except for low ALT. Albumin is slightly elevated, likely clinically insignificant. No acute organ dysfunction is evident. Recommend clinical correlation for cytopenias and metabolic risk management.
